scope: Every saved proposal graph/trade and actual LP candidate/model/numerical merit is checked. Every usable LP gets exact rational primal/dual bounds; a strictly positive lower bound excludes only its fixed candidate. Accepted-state/cache/best provenance is replayed. Native local gates are checked for input, export, hash, cap and status consistency only, without independent enumeration or pair-support replay. Caps are skips, not exclusions. This is not proof of exact optimum, zero-defect exact feasibility, a completed graph, all sampled-neighbor exclusion, or global coverage.
